title: Buzz Aldrin's Apollo 11 sighting retold on Larry King Live

tellings.quote: You know, like with the case of Buzz Aldrin, I was on Larry King Live once with Buzz Aldrin and a couple of the UFO people.

related.note: The same Larry King Live appearance with Buzz Aldrin and UFO people that James Fox describes. Shermer's account seems to present Aldrin's explanation as honest, while Fox says Aldrin lied because someone had got to him.

plain: The Apollo 11 astronaut Buzz Aldrin's account of something he saw during the 1969 Moon mission came up on the television talk show Larry King Live, with Aldrin in the studio. A skeptic and writer named Michael Shermer tells Michels he was on that show with Aldrin and "a couple of the UFO people". He brings up Aldrin's case as an example of how a sighting gets retold, which matters because the sighting is often cited as an astronaut's report of a UFO.
